cli.pageDescription: Share files from your terminal, too. Install the CLI tool via npm, or use curl to get started instantly.
cli.curlDescription: No installation needed. Use curl to upload and download files.
cli.curlPathHint: @myfile.txt can be a relative or absolute path, e.g. @./photo.png or @/home/user/file.txt
cli.binaryUploadHint: To upload multiple files, separate them with spaces. e.g. share upload a.txt b.png
cli.binaryUploadPathHint: You can use file paths instead of just names. e.g. share upload ./docs/a.txt
cli.binarySecureUploadHint: Files are sent directly to the receiver without being stored on the server. Both parties must be online.
cli.binaryDownloadHint: Add a path after the code to specify where to save. e.g. share download 123456 ./downloads/
cli.binaryBrowserAuthHint: Sign in directly from your browser without a token
cli.optionsDescription: Options available when uploading with a Personal Token.
cli.optionsNote: All options above require a Personal Token. Without a Personal Token, files expire in 30 minutes with no additional options.
